title: Midgard live-link message
description: Messages between the editor and a running midgard_runtime over TCP. Each message is a 4-byte big-endian length followed by UTF-8 JSON. Contract v0.

oneOf.description: Sent by both sides when the connection opens.
Editor → runtime: start or stop play.
Editor → runtime: an asset was re-cooked into game.pak (and the manifest rewritten) and should be reloaded. id is the content id.

Editor → runtime: a database row changed (hot reload of data). The editor has already rewritten the package database; the runtime reads the row again. Tables used so far: scene (key = scene id), entity (key = entity id).
Editor → runtime: set one component of one entity. A null value removes the component.
Editor → runtime: add an entity, or replace its name, parent and all of its components. Same shape as a row of the entity table.
Editor → runtime: remove an entity. Its children lose their parent.
Editor → runtime: a script module's file changed in the package's scripts/ folder; the runtime re-imports it.

Editor → runtime: an object's template changed (a re-imported model, its settings or materials); every instance of it is filled in again. Its meshes and textures are in game.pak first (asset.changed). parts is the object table's parts: [] for an object that is gone.
Runtime → editor: a script raised an error and is paused until it is reloaded. file is relative to scripts/; file and line are empty and 0 when unknown.
Runtime → editor: the player paused or resumed from the game window (F6).
Runtime → editor: performance figures, about once a second.
